Name: Fish Chooser
Author: Herikliz
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
[b]Fish Chooser[/b] is a mod that gives you absolute control over your fishing in Stardew Valley. Tired of catching trash or spending days trying to catch that one specific fish for the Community Center? With this mod, simply press a hotkey to open a menu with available fish and select exactly what you want to bite the hook next. Simple, practical, and straight to the point

[b]Installation instructions[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest [b]SMAPI[/b][b] (Stardew Modding API)[/b].[/*]
[*]Download the main [b]Fish Chooser[/b] file from the "Files" tab.[/*]
[*]Extract the contents of the .zip file into your game's Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through the SMAPI shortcut.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Main features[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Fishing on Demand:[/b] Press the hotkey Q to open an elegant scroll menu with all the fish that can be caught in your current location and time. From there, you can select the quality of the fish you catch, but please note that this functionality might be slightly buggy.[/*]
[*][b]GMCM Integration:[/b] Fully compatible with the [i]Generic Mod Config Menu[/i]. You can change the hotkey, toggle the entire mod on/off, or enable the "Allow All Fish" feature directly in the in-game settings.[/*]
[*][b]Quickly Return to Normal:[/b] The menu includes a "Disable (Normal Fishing)" option in case you want to cancel your selection and go back to random fishing.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Instructions[/b]
1. [b]Open the menu:[/b] Press the Q key on your keyboard while playing.
2. [b]Choose the fish:[/b] A list will appear on the screen. Click on the name of the fish you want.
3. [b]Fish:[/b] Cast your fishing rod into the water. You will catch the fish you chose.
4. [b]Return to normal fishing:[/b] Press the Q key again to open the menu, scroll down the list to the bottom and click the red "Disable (Normal Fishing)" button.

[url=https://github.com/Herikliz/FishChooser]View the C# code on Github![/url]
